_provenance: NSE's live "latest announcements" feed (nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/RSS/Online_announcements.xml), captured to a committed snapshot. Company names, subjects and the filing PDF are NSE's own, reproduced unchanged; the document stays on their server and every row links to it where NSE gave a link. The ticker on each row is this dashboard's resolution of the filing company's name to an NSE symbol, so the feed can be narrowed to a reader's holdings; a name we cannot place keeps ticker null and shows only in Universe. Nothing here is scored, ranked or judged.
